passage.label: By sky containing great stars; promised Day; witness what witnessed; Cursed companions trench; fire full fuel; sitting near it; what doing against believers witnesses; resented not except believed Allah Exalted Might Praiseworthy; belongs dominion heavens earth Allah over all Witness

arabicExcerpts.text: وَهُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفۡعَلُونَ بِٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ شُهُودٞ
وَمَا نَقَمُواْ مِنۡهُمۡ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤۡمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَمِيدِ
ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ شَهِيدٌ

mainSubject.label: Oaths by the sky containing great stars, the promised Day, and the witness with what is witnessed; the companions of the trench cursed — a fire full of fuel beside which they sat, witnessing their own treatment of the believers; their resentment directed at nothing but belief in Allah, the Exalted in Might and Praiseworthy, whose dominion covers heavens and earth while He is Witness over all things

subordinateSubjects.label: Oath sworn by the sky containing great stars
And by the witness together with what is witnessed
The companions of the trench cursed
Their trench described as a fire full of fuel

Witnessing their own treatment of the believers

His dominion over heavens and earth affirmed with Him as Witness over all things

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Resentment directed solely at belief in Allah rather than any worldly grievance
Persecutors seated beside their own fire witnessing their treatment of believers

socialEconomicCivilisational.label: The trench episode: organised burning of believers as religious persecution

relationships.label: Three-fold oath by the star-bearing sky, the promised Day and the witness with what is witnessed
Dominion over heavens and earth joined to universal witnessing of the persecution

notes: Wave 12 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the dominion-and-Witness affirmation (9) before the torturer-versus-believer verdict opens (10); P2 ends with the Effecter-of-what-He-intends attribute (16) before the soldiers' precedent begins (17); P3 runs through Pharaoh and Thamud, the encompassment statement and the closing Preserved-Slate affirmation (17-22).
